description: In server.rs route_method Email/query for the special-mailbox path, the SQL OFFSET is set to response_position (position clamped to total). However response_position = position.min(total), and OFFSET in SQL is row count, not message count. If position > total, OFFSET=total returns an empty page — which is correct — but the response returns position=total instead of the requested position. RFC 8620 §5.5 says position in the response MUST be the index of the first result returned. When OFFSET > COUNT(*), no rows are returned and position should be clamped to total, which the code does. title: Email/query for special mailbox: position parameter used as OFFSET directly
